lines.en: label callutaafternoon:
if senseisad == True:
I don't want to call her right now...
lines.zh: 我现在不想叫她……

lines.en: jump callafternoon
if utablock == True:
I don't think I should call Uta right now...
lines.zh: 我觉得现在不该打给 Uta……

lines.en: jump callafternoon
if chapthreeactive == True:
I tap on Uta's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Uta 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: There's no answer. I guess she's busy right now.
lines.zh: 没人接。看来她现在在忙。

lines.en: jump callafternoon
else:
I tap on Uta's name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
lines.zh: 我在手机上点开 Uta 的名字，等她接电话。

lines.en: : Yooooooooooo! What's up, dawg?
lines.zh: : 哟哟哟哟哟！怎么了，老铁？

lines.en: : Sorry. I think I may have called the wrong number.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我可能打错号码了。

lines.en: : Nonononono! It's me! Uta! The world's most adorablest maid and your best bud!
lines.zh: : 不不不不不！是我！Uta！全世界最可爱哒女仆，你的好兄弟！

lines.en: : Please don't ever call me {i}dawg{/i} again. I am a human.
lines.zh: : 拜托以后别再叫我{i}老铁{/i}了。我是人类。

lines.en: : Blah blah blah bark bark bark. Let's do karaoke!
lines.zh: : 废话废话废话汪汪汪。我们去唱卡拉OK吧！

lines.en: if bonus == True:
: Are you going to try and kiss me again?
lines.zh: : 你又要试着亲我吗？

lines.en: : Me? Kiss {i}you{/i}?
else:
: Are we actually going to hug this time? Because I feel like we've been pretty close-
lines.zh: : 这次我们真的会抱上吗？因为我觉得我们已经很接近了——

lines.en: : Sensei, you must be misremembering something. I would never ever {i}ever{/i} do that!
lines.zh: : Sensei，你一定是记错什么了。我绝对绝对{i}绝对{/i}不会做那种事！

lines.en: : That really hurts.
lines.zh: : 这话真伤人。

lines.en: : Well, quit your whining and meet me at the singing booth so I can knock out some songs before work!
lines.zh: : 那就别抱怨了，来唱歌包间找我，让我在上班前把几首歌刷完！

lines.en: scene black
Uta hangs up on me, one of the greatest taboos of all, and I quickly find myself heading over to the karaoke place.
lines.zh: Uta 挂了电话——这是所有禁忌里最大的一条——很快我就发现自己已经在去卡拉OK的路上了。

lines.en: scene utanoongen
As expected, minimal attention is provided to me this afternoon.
lines.zh: 果然，这个下午她几乎没怎么理我。

lines.en: But that's okay- because intentional neglect is still a form of attention.
lines.zh: 不过没关系——因为刻意的冷落，也算是一种关注。

lines.en: However, neglect itself calls into question whether or not it {i}is{/i} intentional and-
lines.zh: 但冷落本身又会让人怀疑，它到底是不是{i}刻意{/i}的，而且——

lines.en: : Uta, do you want to stop singing and maybe talk for a little while?
lines.zh: : Uta，你要不要先别唱了，我们聊一会儿？

lines.en: : No can do, Sensei! I'm on a hot streak!
lines.zh: : 不行哦，Sensei！我正连着好几首呢！

lines.en: : Grab a mic and sing along if you're so desperate for some Ushibori time!
lines.zh: : 你要是这么渴望 Ushibori 时间，就自己抓个麦克风一起唱！

lines.en: I decide against grabbing a microphone and elect to continue watching Uta instead.
lines.zh: 我决定不去抓麦克风，继续看着 Uta。

lines.en: scene black
This goes on for roughly half an hour before she runs out of breath and needs to take a break.
lines.zh: 就这样过了大约半小时，她才唱到没气，需要休息一下。

lines.en: During that time, I avoid being neglected and manage to grow a little closer to Uta.
lines.zh: 那段时间里，我躲开了被冷落，也算和 Uta 稍微近了一点。

lines.en: Even if she would likely take karaoke over {i}me{/i} any day of the week.
lines.zh: 尽管她大概宁愿要卡拉OK，也不要{i}我{/i}——一周七天都是如此。

lines.en: $ uta_love += 1
lines.zh: $ uta_love += 1

lines.en: {i}Uta's affection has increased to [uta_love]!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}Uta 的好感度提升到了 [uta_love]!{/i}

lines.en: jump saturdaynight
